Summary: HotpotQA is a large-scale multi-hop question answering benchmark featuring 112,779 Wikipedia-based Q&A pairs with detailed, sentence-level supporting evidence. Baseline performance statistics show that the model's F1 score drops from 58.99% in the distractor setting to 34.40% in the full wiki setting, highlighting the substantial challenge posed by real-world information retrieval. The full wiki setting tests the model’s ability to locate relevant facts and reason about them without specified gold paragraphs, and performance metrics show moderate retrieval with a Mean Average Precision (MAP) of 43.21% and Hits@10 at 55.88%.
